label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group interventional study with no allocation, and the described arm gives all patients the stem cell injections. There is no comparator arm or inactive/placebo treatment described, so a placebo is not part of the design.

evidence.quote: three intrathecal injections of 50 million cells

title: Safety of Cultured Allogeneic Adult Umbilical Cord or Placental Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cell Intrathecal Injection for ALS

rule.label: No placebo
rule.reason: All recorded arms have recognized non-placebo types and no placebo mention in arms/interventions. Inferred from saved data; sham controls count as no placebo.
